name: Dragonoid
description: The flagship Pyrus Bakugan. High speed and magnet make it excellent at field control and standing on Gate Cards.
special_shot_description: Cloaked in fiery aura, shoots like rocket. If hits opposing Bakugan while active → Critical KO, win Gate Card without fight.

source.source_notes: G-Power 400/650. Stats from guide table. Pyrus attribute only.

name: Preyas
description: Aquos trickster. High control allows precise movement. Once stands on a Gate Card, roulette randomly becomes Aquos, Subterra, or Darkus.

source.source_notes: G-Power 380/630. Stats from guide table. Aquos attribute only. Preyas gimmick: random attribute roulette on stand.

name: Gorem
description: The tank of Subterra. Maximum defense makes it incredibly hard to Critical KO. Low steering and magnet compensate.

source.source_notes: G-Power 400/650. Stats from guide table. Subterra attribute only.

name: Tigrerra
description: Haos speedster with strong magnet. Low control makes precise movement challenging but magnet helps with standing.

source.source_notes: G-Power 400/650. Stats from guide table. Haos attribute only.

name: Hydranoid
description: The powerhouse of Darkus. Highest base G-Power among the six. Excellent steering for long field control, but low control makes turning sluggish.
special_shot_description: Dark aura. Completely intangible — moves through other Bakugan. Disables opponent influence on angle. When stands, remains intangible → immune to Critical KOs from Pyrus Strike. Still vulnerable to Subterra Quake.

source.source_notes: G-Power 450/700. Stats from guide table. Darkus attribute only. Highest base G-Power.

name: Skyress
description: Ventus wind rider. Exceptional steering for maximum field time. Low defense makes it vulnerable to Critical KOs.

source.source_notes: G-Power 400/650. Stats from guide table. Ventus attribute only.
